اجتذبنا (form VIII)
# اِجْتَذَبْنَا (ijtaḏabnā) /id͡ʒ.ta.ðab.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اُجْتُذِبْنَا (ujtuḏibnā) /ud͡ʒ.tu.ðib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
